title: Fare Review Team Standard: Detour Delay Referral Amount on Wayfare Rides
content:
**Standard.** The detour delay referral amount for a trip of **Wayfare Rides (rider trips and fares)** is the compensable delay minutes multiplied by the ride option's per-minute rate and by the minute-value factor, then by the referral timeliness factor; the figure is limited to the referral cap and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

- **Compensable delay minutes**: the measured delay minutes less the delay grace minutes, and never below zero.
- **Measured delay minutes**: the trip's actual minutes less its estimated minutes.
- **Per-minute rate**: the per-minute rate of the ride option the trip was requested under.

| Quantity | Value |
|---|---|
| Delay grace minutes | 10 minutes |
| Minute-value factor | 1.0 |
| Referral timeliness factor | 1.0 |
| Referral cap | $6.00 |

## Input, judgement, output

| Input | Judgement | Output |
|---|---|---|
| actual and estimated minutes | actual minutes less estimated minutes | measured delay minutes |
| measured delay minutes | less 10 grace minutes; a negative result counts as zero | compensable delay minutes |
| compensable minutes, per-minute rate | multiplied together, then by 1.0 and by 1.0, unrounded | referral figure |
| referral figure | held at or below $6.00, then rounded half up to the cent | referral amount |

## Worked examples (hypothetical trips; hypothetical per-minute rate $0.30)

- Estimated 22 minutes, actual 41: measured 19, compensable 9; 9 times $0.30 is $2.70; within the cap — **$2.70**.
- Estimated 18 minutes, actual 25: measured 7, less 10 is below zero, so compensable 0 — **$0.00**.
- Estimated 20 minutes, actual 50 at a hypothetical per-minute rate of $0.40: measured 30, compensable 20; 20 times $0.40 is $8.00, held to the cap — **$6.00**.
